ticks.note: Tick 1: both charts start with `ring` = `{1, 2, 3}`. Their self-loops are delayed.

`Rotate` runs `ring[0] = ring[1]; ring[1] = ring[2]; ring[2] = ring[0]`, in that order. By the time `ring[2]` is assigned, `ring[0]` is already 2, so it gets `{2, 3, 2}`: the 1 is lost. `RotateTemp` saved `ring[0]` in `first` before the vector assignment, so its last element gets the 1 back: `{2, 3, 1}`.
`Rotate` is back to `{2, 3, 2}` and never rotates. `RotateTemp` is back to `{1, 2, 3}` after three rotations.
